channelDefinitions.name: Effects speed and sound control sensitivity

ranges.description:
Automatic colour change as set by channel 1, decreasing speed from fast to slow if channel 1 = 64…127
Automatic colour change as set by channel 1, increasing speed from slow to fast if channel 1 = 128…191
Sound control sensitivity (from low to high sensitivity) if channel 1 = 192…255
One of 31 preprogrammed colours, channels 8 and 9 without function
Strobe effect, increasing speed, if channel 7 = 0…15
Constant colour, the hue is set by channels 2 to 5
Automatic colour change with 14 colours, channels 2-7 without function
Automatic colour change with 24 colours, channels 2-7 without function
Automatic colour change with 6 colours, channels 2-7 without function
Constant colour, the hue is set by channels 1 to 6
Fade-out effect, speed controlled by channel 8
Fade-in effect, speed controlled by channel 8
Fade-in-out effect, speed controlled by channel 8
Auto-mix effect, speed controlled by channel 8, channels 1 to 7 without function
Chase (4 colours), speed controlled by channel 8, channels 1 to 7 without function
Chase (12 colours), speed controlled by channel 8, channels 1 to 7 without function
